motivation: KNOW30 and KNOW31 held worlds used c=t%4 and a=t%4, leaving physical input4 unobserved for every allowed hidden action map. Test whether balanced public action coverage restores causal memory under observed B interference, rather than rerunning failed fixed-tape cohorts.
question: With all eight physical inputs reachable per 16-action phase, can the original full-posterior A/B write-quarantine learner retain old A and recover after unannounced B better than the same-size approximate switching Bayes and a rolling-last8 model, including an unfamiliar B law in the same Boolean table family?

source.public_observations: At each t, policies see only c=t%4, selected opaque action a=floor(t/4)%4, and one Bernoulli consequence (.85 if hidden rule(c XOR private_map[a]) else .15). No phase/map/rule/private coin/future outcomes enter model.
source.phase: A t0..15; hidden B t16..31; unannounced A t32..47. Also matched A-continuation fork from identical cold t16 prefix; fork is evaluator-only.
source.coin: SHA256 private domain above, first unsigned64/2^64, shared exogenous coin across policies/forks at each (map,seed,t). Prefix generated once, then both forks deep-cold-cloned.
source.public_tape: c=t%4; a=(t//4)%4; in each consecutive 16 steps every (c,a) pair occurs exactly once; each of the eight physical input positions is reached at least once under all six possible maps; 48 total steps per fork.
source.historical_FIT: Exactly the previously consumed KNOW26 mapping prior 108 witnesses per map plus KNOW30 known A/H2-B labelled FIT 128 witnesses per map, provided equally to all FIT arms. A newly unfamiliar H1-B is NOT added to FIT. No reuse of prior HELD seeds.
source.held_first_use: 24 new source-only worlds; first-run only after frozen prereg, source/test qualification, exact G29 atlas seal, dual OS mandatory full final and original-source read-only compatibility. Unit tests must never open held synthetic outcomes. If uncertain execution/CI effects, fail closed; no replay.

measure.primary: Mean held treatment return-A expected Brier after k=4 and k=8 witnessed return actions, q under H0, four evaluator-only held c4..7 no-op forecasts; compare separately per B family with fair same-information switching-HMM and rolling8.
secondary: old-A slot true H0 expected Brier at t16, t32 before return, after k8; byte-cold clone A-slot digest/readouts; received vs assimilated witnesses; prequential B-phase Brier, A-continuation paired t32 drift, per-world and per-family paired losses
Physical input coverage by each public 16-step tape and map (all8), context4 no-op posterior after A, B and return; report observed physical coverage separately from predictive advantage
Runtime, stored checkpoint bytes, phase-belief, write quarantine counts, no-FIT and fully informed controls clearly labelled incomparable if added
measure.score: Brier(q,p)=q*(1-q)+(p-q)^2; lower is better, no scorer labels used for learning.
measure.sampling: 3 maps x8 fresh seeds=24 worlds, 12 with known H2 B and 12 with unfamiliar H1 B, 48 witnessed steps per fork. No population-significance claim from this small, structured cohort.

budgets.action_privilege: Fixed public action tape identical for all methods; no action selection or differential intervention cost.
budgets.compute: Record CPU and total wall; exact full 2-regime HMM not claimed, original switching baseline is mean-field approximation.

frozen.P0: For EACH mapping candidate, each 16-step public phase tape reaches all 8 physical input positions, and all 16 public (c,a) pairs exactly once. Fail no scoring if not true.
frozen.P1: At t16 archived A-slot has mean A-law high-context expected Brier <=0.235 across 24 worlds; else UNDERTRAINED baseline and no positive memory claim.
frozen.H1: Mean archive B-treatment k8 return-A Brier <= BOTH approximate HMM and rolling8 by >=0.005 absolute in EACH B-law family of 12 worlds, with archive winning >=9/12 pairs against each in EACH family.
frozen.H2: Live archive A-slot SHA and four high-context forecasts exactly equal immediately after common A-prefix t16 and after B-treatment t32 in ALL 24 worlds, no B-phase A writes. Frozen copy alone is insufficient.
frozen.H3: Average treatment B-phase high-context expected Brier for candidate <= approximate HMM+0.005 on EACH B family; cannot trade away learning changed B.
frozen.H4: All 24 worlds exact source identity, one A-prefix witnessed outcome per t, each fork receives sequential 48 public outcomes, held/private values denied to policy, independently cold-restored checkpoint byte and forecast equality, lower-level tampering and replay rejected, full Linux+Windows regression and read-only historical compatibility before one held run.
frozen.decision: DEVELOPMENT_SUPPORTED if P0,P1,H1,H2,H3,H4 all true. Else DEVELOPMENT_MIXED_OR_NO_GO, UNDERTRAINED if P1 false, INVALID if P0/H4 fail. SCIENTIFIC_PASS_ALWAYS_FALSE for synthetic conventional prototype, no native causal gain/promotion. Preserve all negatives and consumed first-use.
frozen.stops: No post-first-use tuning, extra seeds/actions, baseline substitution, threshold edits, replay or promotion.
